E2941

Unknown proof lens `{value}`

What

Unknown proof lens `{value}`

Why

`jet prove` accepts `all`, `refinements`, `effects`, `taint`, `contracts`, `tests`, `budgets`, `replay`, and `solver`.

Fix

use one exact value, for example `jet prove TARGET --lens tests`.
